  "pros": [
    "Simplified project management for tracking tasks.",
    "Helps organize and follow up on work effectively.",
    "Provides a centralized space for operations."

  "cons": [
    "Requires a learning curve when transitioning from Excel.",
    "Limited customization options compared to other tools.",
    "Cannot edit multiple lines simultaneously."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The coordinator found Smartsheet to be a significant improvement over Excel for managing and following up on work within their small import and export company. They appreciated its ability to simplify project management and provide a centralized, organized workspace. While there was a learning curve and some limitations in customization and bulk editing, the overall functionality greatly aided their operational tasks."
